_readme: Curated images for individual animals; clade images are unchanged.
File URLs, artists and licences were verified against Wikimedia Commons imageinfo metadata.
Images remain hosted on Wikimedia under their individual licences; this file contains links and credits.
Keys are exact scientific names from dinosaur-database.json. These picks override wiki-cache.json and live image selection.
An override changes the image without removing the cached Wikipedia description.
To change a pick, update imageUrl, fallbackUrl (another size of the SAME file), imageTitle, artist, fileUrl, licenseName and licenseUrl together.
Cache regeneration does not overwrite this file.
